## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{X_A} - \bar{X_B}}{\sqrt{\frac{s_A^2}{N_A} + \frac{s_B^2}{N_B}}}
$${#eq-welch}

## Examples {.unnumbered}


If the assumption of equal variances is violated (Levene's test $p < 0.05$), we use `oneway.test()` in base R.

```{r}
#| echo: true

# 1. Run Welch's ANOVA (var.equal = FALSE is the default)
welch_anova <- oneway.test(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth, var.equal = FALSE)
print(welch_anova)
```

Bug here fix!!
```{r}
#| echo: true
#| message: false

# Load necessary libraries
library(PMCMRplus)
library(multcompView)

# 1. Run Games-Howell test
gh_test <- gamesHowellTest(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth)
print(gh_test)

# 2. Extract P-values to create a significance matrix
# Games-Howell output needs to be formatted for multcompLetters
p_values <- gh_test$p.value

# Convert the triangular matrix to a full symmetric matrix for multcompLetters
# This step creates a named vector of p-values for all comparisons
p_vec <- as.vector(p_values)
names(p_vec) <- c("trt1-ctrl", "trt2-ctrl", "trt2-trt1") # Map names to the matrix values
p_vec <- p_vec[!is.na(p_vec)] # Remove NAs

# 3. Generate Letters
gh_letters_obj <- multcompLetters(p_vec)
gh_letters <- gh_letters_obj$Letters

# 4. Reorder to match the factor levels (ctrl, trt1, trt2)
ordered_letters <- gh_letters[levels(PlantGrowth$group)]
```

```{r}
#| echo: true

# Create the boxplot
boxplot(weight ~ group, data = PlantGrowth,
        main = "Plant Weight: Welch's ANOVA + Games-Howell",
        col = c("#FF9999", "#99FF99", "#9999FF"),
        ylim = c(3, 8))

# Calculate max positions
max_weights <- tapply(PlantGrowth$weight, PlantGrowth$group, max)

# Add letters
text(x = 1:3,
     y = max_weights + 0.3,
     labels = ordered_letters,
     cex = 1.5,
     font = 2,
     col = "blue")
```
